Decipher.com cardlists archive face for [[Ralltiir (Dark)]] (A New Hope, Dark Side), '''rotated 180°''' from [[:File:ANH-D-ralltiir-decipher-archive.gif]], no other change. Decipher's scan is stored upside down (Light Side text at the bottom); this copy shows the Dark Side text the right way up.

The rotation is lossless: same 367×506 size, same pixels and palette, no rescaling (checked: rotating this file back by 180° gives the archive scan pixel for pixel).
